SDCL 53-2-6 governs the right to enforce a contract as a third-party 
beneficicj ry. The statute provides, "[a) contract made expressly for the 
benefit of a third person may be enforced by him at any time before the 
parties thereto rescind it." SDCL 53 2-6 (emphasis added). This does 
not, how('v-.>r, entitle every person who received some benefit from the 
contract to enforce it. As this Court stated in Thompson Yards v. Van 
Nice, 59 S.D. 306, 308, 239 N.W. 753, 755 (1931):
